name: User Role
description: Adds a versioned custom user role class extending AbstractUserRole from rtcamp/wp-framework. The framework re-registers the role only when get_version() increases.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the role class. Default 'Inc\Roles' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the role file. Default 'includes/Roles'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Roles'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Roles'.
Role slug, lowercase, snake- or kebab-case, e.g. 'shop_manager'.
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.

wiring.description: Add the role to the Roles module so the framework Loader runs maybe_update_role() on admin_init. If the Roles module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Roles --kind=user-role`.
